full_text_zh:
[P1] 市政局兒童文學叢書第七輯
短·耳·朵·的·洛·洛
市政局公共圖書館出版

[P2] 序言
市政局公共圖書館自一九八一年創辦「中文兒童讀物創作獎」以來，一直將歷屆「兒童故事組」及「圖畫故事組」的獲獎作品編印成《市政局兒童文學叢書》，公開發售。多年來，幸獲家長、教師及各界人士支持，這套叢書的銷量甚為理想。
出版《市政局兒童文學叢書》的目的，是為下一代提供豐富的精神食糧，培養兒童對閱讀的興趣，使他們茁壯成長。現代文明社會，物質引誘繁多，兒童容易變得早熟、世故。我們希望多創作具有教育意義的趣味故事，藉以促進兒童心智的成長，擴闊他們的胸襟。
本叢書第七輯是一九八八年度「中文兒童讀物創作獎」得獎作品的結集，包括圖畫故事書三冊及兒童故事書一冊。收入本叢書的故事，取材皆源於生活，卻不囿於真實世界，因而得以豐富兒童的想像，啓發他們的思考。如果兒童能夠領悟書中所傳達的勵志訊息，從而學習投入生活，培養正確的價值觀，建立豐盛的人生，那麼，這套叢書可算是收到預期效果了。
市政局主席
霍士傑
一九八九年十一月二十四日

[P3] 作者簡歷
李炳輝，一九六一年出生於香港。一九八一年獲全港青年學藝繪畫比賽西洋畫組
冠軍；一九八六年畢業於葛量洪教育學院，並任職中學美術教師至今；一九八八年畢
業於香港理工學院夜校基本設計證書課程。
楊麗珊，一九六一年出生於香港。一九八一年畢業於香港理工學院幼兒工作證書
課程，並任職幼兒工作至八三年；一九八六年畢業於葛量洪教育學院，並任教於聾童
學校至今。
作者的話
《短耳朵的洛洛》是我倆在這類型創作中的第一部作品，沒有甚麼特別的心得，而很多不
足之處仍需待將來改進。
在《短耳朵的洛洛》的編繪過程中，我們體會到創作兒童圖畫故事書時要顧及創作意念、
技巧及責任等問題。創作意念若是生活化，兒童便會較容易產生共鳴，從而領悟其中的真
意。但帶有幻想的創作也不容忽視，因為這樣可以豐富兒童的想像力。至於作品的寓意則須
清晰明確，好使小讀者容易理解，並能產生潛移默化的效果。
為了使故事更生動，繪畫技巧是重要的一環。有趣的造型、恰當的着色、構圖的變化、
畫面的編排等都能使插圖與文字互相輝映，留給小讀者深刻的印象。
最後，藉著《短耳朵的洛洛》，我倆希望身體傷殘的兒童能鼓起勇氣積極地生活，努力發
揮一己之所長；而身體健全的，則學習多瞭解、多接納這些朋友。

[P4] 一九八八年度市政局中文兒童讀物創作獎
短·耳·朵·的·洛·洛

圖畫故事組第一名
著者：李炳輝·楊麗珊

市政局公共圖書館出版

[P5] 在很遠的地方，有一個美麗的森林。

[P7] 森林的一角住著一大群兔子。

[P8] 有一天，兔爸爸的家中传出了一件大喜讯。

[P9] 原來小兔子快將出世了，兔爸爸正在屋內急得團團轉。

[P10] 忽然，「哇哇！哇呀！」的哭声从兔妈妈的房内传出。

[P11] 於是，所有兔子都歡天喜地地衝向房內，希望能盡快看看趣緻的小兔子的樣貌。

[P12] 突然，大家都呆了下来，究竟发生了什么事呢？

[P13] 小兔子确是出世了，而且不只一只啊！一、二，原来是一对孖生兔兄弟；可是，更奇怪的是怎么其中一只小兔子的耳朵竟然生得十分短小呢？

[P14] 日子一天一天地過去，有一對正常耳朵的兔哥哥浩浩，與沒有正常耳朵的弟弟洛洛漸漸長大了。

[P15] 可是，洛洛對於周圍的聲音，都只聽得一片低沉微弱的「㗅……咕㗅……咯……咯……咕咕……」。因此，洛洛一直都很不開心，更覺得自己比不上別的兔子。

[P16] 上學去
至於講說話，洛洛自知自己的聲音怪異，於是沒有努力學習講說話。

[P17] 很多時候，洛洛請求哥哥及別的兔子讓牠與牠們一起玩，但總是被牠們拒絕。

[P18] 洛洛唯有伤心地离去。

[P19] 偶然，當洛洛獨個兒發悶時，便會胡亂地哼著歌，而一旦被其他兔子聽到，牠們便會取笑洛洛一番。

[P20] 在一個深夜裏，洛洛在牀上翻來覆去，牠回想起白天常被別的兔子嘲笑的情景，牠更想及自己的怪模樣和將來不快樂的日子……。

[P21] 洛洛无论怎样也睡不着觉，便静悄悄地到外边散步，希望清醒一下混沌的脑子。

[P22] 於是，洛洛便沿著山頂的小路走。

[P23] 洛洛边行边想，牠突然想起了很疼爱牠的爸爸和妈妈的仁慈面孔。

[P24] 洛洛想起了爸妈与他一起玩耍的愉快时光。

[P25] 洛洛更想起了媽媽對他的鼓勵：「我的孩子，千萬不要因為身體上的殘缺而不開心，只有愛心，才是最重要的啊！」

[P26] 當洛洛回望牠的家園時，猛然地發覺森林正著了火。

[P27] 洛洛不顾一切地往森林飞奔。

[P28] 雖然洛洛發音不準，但他拼命地邊跑邊嚷著，希望吵醒已熟睡的兔子。

[P29] 很快的，所有兔子都被洛洛的叫喊声吵醒了。于是，取水的取水，救火的救火，全部兔子都拼命的与大火搏斗。

[P30] 過了片刻，大火終於被撲滅了，洛洛救回了全森林的兔子及整個兔子的家園。

[P31] 這時，浩浩和其他兔子都醒悟到以前牠們看不起洛洛是錯誤的，牠們紛紛向洛洛道歉，並答應以後也與牠一起玩耍、學習。

[P32] 經過這件事情後，在爸媽的懷抱裏，洛洛體會到自己應努力學習講說話；雖然自己的耳朵有缺陷，但仍有其他方面的用處呢！

[P33] 短耳朶的洛洛
著者：李炳輝 楊麗珊
出版：市政局公共圖書館
承印：怡和印刷有限公司
一九九〇年一月出版
定價：HK$10
UC 10533
ISBN 962-7038-45-8

Published and Printed in Hong Kong

[P34] 定價：HK$10

[P1] Municipal Council Children's Literature Series, Volume 7
Short-Eared Lolo
Published by Municipal Council Public Libraries

[P2] Preface
Since the Urban Council Public Libraries launched the "Chinese Children's Reading Material Creation Award" in 1981, they have compiled the winning entries from the "Children's Story Category" and the "Picture Story Category" into the "Urban Council Children's Literature Series" and made them available for public sale. Over the years, with the support of parents, teachers, and the public, the sales of this series have been very successful.
The purpose of publishing the "Urban Council Children's Literature Series" is to provide rich spiritual nourishment for the next generation, cultivate children's interest in reading, and help them grow up healthily. In modern civilized society, with abundant material temptations, children tend to become mature and worldly too early. We hope to create more interesting stories with educational value to promote children's mental development and broaden their horizons.
The seventh volume of this series is a collection of winning works from the 1988 "Chinese Children's Reading Material Creation Award", including three picture storybooks and one children's storybook. The stories included in this series are drawn from real life, yet not confined to reality, thus enriching children's imagination and stimulating their thinking. If children can understand the inspirational messages conveyed in the books, learn to engage with life, cultivate correct values, and build a fulfilling life, then this series can be considered to have achieved its intended effect.
Chairman of the Urban Council
Ho Siu-Kit
November 24, 1989

[P3] Author's Biography
Li Binghui, born in Hong Kong in 1961. In 1981, he won the Western Painting Category of the Hong Kong Youth Arts and Crafts Painting Competition; in 1986, he graduated from the葛量洪 Education College and has been working as a secondary school art teacher since then; in 1988, he completed the Basic Design Certificate Course at the Hong Kong Polytechnic Night School.
Yang Lishan, born in Hong Kong in 1961. In 1981, she graduated from the Hong Kong Polytechnic Institute's Early Childhood Work Certificate Program and worked in early childhood education until 1983; in 1986, she graduated from the葛量洪 Education College and has been teaching at a school for deaf children since then.
Author's Note
"Short-Eared Lolo" is our first work in this type of creation, and we don't have any special insights, and many shortcomings still need to be improved in the future.
During the creation and illustration process of "Short-Eared Lolo", we realized that creating children's picture storybooks requires consideration of creative concepts, techniques, and responsibilities. If the creative concept is life-related, children can more easily resonate with it and thus understand its true meaning. However, imaginative creations should not be ignored, as they can enrich children's imagination. The meaning of the work must also be clear and explicit, so that young readers can easily understand it and achieve a subtle, transformative effect.
To make the story more vivid, illustration techniques are an important aspect. Interesting character designs, appropriate coloring, varied compositions, and thoughtful layout arrangements can all make the illustrations complement the text, leaving a deep impression on young readers.
Finally, through "Short-Eared Lolo", we hope that children with physical disabilities can muster courage to live actively and strive to develop their own strengths; and for children who are physically healthy, we hope they learn to understand and accept these friends more.

[P4] 1988 Municipal Council Chinese Children's Reading Material Creation Award
Short-Eared Lolo

First Prize, Illustrated Story Category
Authors: Li Binghui · Yang Lishan

Published by Municipal Council Public Library

[P5] In a faraway place, there was a beautiful forest.

[P7] In a corner of the forest, a big group of rabbits lived.

[P8] One day, a big piece of good news came from Mr. Rabbit's home.

[P9] It turns out the little rabbit is about to be born, and Rabbit Dad is anxiously pacing around inside the house.

[P10] Suddenly, the crying sound of "Wah wah! Wah ya!" came from inside the rabbit mother's room.

[P11] So, all the rabbits joyfully rushed into the room, hoping to see the cute little rabbit as soon as possible.

[P12] Suddenly, everyone froze. What on earth had happened?

[P13] The little rabbits have indeed been born, and not just one! One, two—turns out they are a pair of twin rabbit brothers. But what's even stranger is how one of the little rabbits has ears that are surprisingly short!

[P14] Days passed one by one. The rabbit brother Haohao, who had normal ears, and his younger brother Luolu, who didn't have normal ears, gradually grew up.

[P15] However, Luo Luo could only hear a faint, muffled sound of 'drip... gurgle... click... click... gurgle...' for all the surrounding noises. Therefore, Luo Luo was always unhappy and felt he was not as good as the other rabbits.

[P16] Go to school
As for speaking, Luo Luo knew his voice was strange, so he didn't make an effort to learn how to speak.

[P17] Often, Lolo asked his brother and other rabbits to let him play with them, but he was always rejected.

[P18] Luo Luo could only leave sadly.

[P19] Occasionally, when Lolo is alone and feeling bored, he will randomly hum a song, and once other rabbits hear it, they will tease Lolo.

[P20] In the middle of a deep night, Lolo tossed and turned in bed, recalling the scenes from the day when other rabbits laughed at him. He also thought about his strange appearance and the unhappy days ahead...

[P21] Lolo couldn't sleep no matter what, so he quietly went out for a walk, hoping to clear his confused mind.

[P22] So, Luo Luo walked along the little path on the mountain top.

[P23] As Lolo walked and thought, he suddenly remembered the kind faces of his loving dad and mom.

[P24] Lolo remembered the happy times he spent playing with his parents.

[P25] Lolo remembered his mother's encouragement: "My child, never be unhappy because of physical imperfections. Only love is truly important!"

[P26] When Lolo looked back at his home, he suddenly realized the forest was on fire.

[P27] Lolo ran towards the forest without hesitation.

[P28] Although Lolo's pronunciation was not accurate, he ran desperately while shouting, hoping to wake up the rabbits who were already asleep.

[P29] Soon, all the rabbits were awakened by Lolo's shouts. So, some fetched water, others fought the fire, and all the rabbits struggled desperately against the blaze.

[P30] After a while, the fire was finally put out, and Lolo saved all the rabbits in the forest and their entire home.

[P31] At this moment, Haohao and the other rabbits realized that it was wrong to have looked down on Luolu before. They all apologized to Luolu and promised to play and study with him from now on.

[P32] After this incident, in his parents' embrace, Lolo realized he should work hard to learn how to speak; although his ears have a defect, he still has other useful qualities!

[P33] Short-Eared Lolo

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《短耳朵的洛洛》，属于市政局儿童文学丛书第七辑，由市政局公共图书馆出版。画面中三只兔子在草地上开心地聚集在一起。
[P2] 本页为绘本《短耳朵的洛洛》的序言页，由市政局主席霍士傑撰写，介绍了《市政局儿童文学丛书》的出版背景、目的及第七辑的组成，强调其教育意义和对儿童成长的积极影响。
[P3] 本页展示了绘本《短耳朵的洛洛》的作者简介及作者的话，包括两位作者李炳辉和杨丽珊的生平经历，以及他们对创作该绘本的心得与期望，强调了作品的教育意义和对儿童的积极影响。
[P4] 本页为绘本《短耳朵的洛洛》的获奖信息页，显示该书获得1988年度市政局中文儿童读物创作奖图画故事组第一名，作者为李炳辉和杨丽珊，由市政局公共图书馆出版。
[P5] 画面描绘了一片远处的美丽森林，有青山、绿树、草地和小溪，两只小动物在草地上，文字说明此处有一个美丽的森林。
[P6] 画面描绘了一片宁静的森林风景，远处是连绵的青山，近处有绿树、草地和一条蜿蜒的小溪，天空呈蓝色并带有云彩，整体氛围清新自然。
[P7] 画面描绘了一片森林角落，有许多色彩鲜艳的蘑菇形状小屋，两只小兔子在草地上玩耍，旁边有小溪流过，文字说明此处住着一大群兔子。
[P8] 画面中一只兔子兴奋地跳跃，下方文字说明兔爸爸家中传出一件大喜讯，故事由此展开。
[P9] 画面中，兔爸爸在屋内焦急地转圈，壁炉燃着火，地上有几只小兔子的耳朵，文字说明小兔子即将出生，兔爸爸非常着急。
[P10] 兔妈妈的房间里传出了小兔子的哭声，兔爸爸显得非常激动，跳了起来，眼镜和烟斗都飞了出去。
[P11] 所有兔子兴奋地冲向房间，想尽快看到新出生的小兔子的模样。
[P12] 画面中一群兔子围在床边，表情惊讶，下方文字提问发生了什么事，暗示情节出现转折。
[P13] 兔妈妈抱着刚出生的一对双胞胎小兔子，其中一只耳朵特别短，引发大家的惊讶。
[P14] 画面展示了两只小兔子，一只耳朵正常，另一只耳朵短小，文字说明它们是双胞胎兄弟浩浩和洛洛，正在一天天长大。
[P15] 洛洛因听力微弱而感到不开心，觉得自己不如其他兔子，画面中他独自坐在栅栏上，而其他兔子在草地上快乐玩耍。
[P16] 画面描绘了兔子们在教室上课的场景，洛洛在课堂上打瞌睡，下方文字说明他因声音怪异而缺乏学习说话的动力。
[P17] 洛洛因听力微弱而被其他兔子排斥，他多次请求一起玩耍但总是被拒绝，画面中他张大嘴巴呼喊，其他兔子则表现出嫌弃或回避的态度。
[P18] 洛洛因被其他兔子排斥而伤心地独自离开，画面中他背对同伴，眼中含泪，其他兔子在草地上玩耍。
[P19] 洛洛独自发闷时会胡乱哼歌，但其他兔子听到后会取笑他，画面中洛洛张嘴哼歌，周围兔子表现出嫌弃或嘲笑的反应。
[P20] 深夜，洛洛在床上辗转反侧，回忆起白天被其他兔子嘲笑的情景，为自己的外貌和未来感到悲伤。
[P21] 洛洛因无法入睡，便悄悄出门散步，希望借此清醒头脑。
[P22] 洛洛在深夜独自沿着山顶的小路散步，画面中他手持树枝，背景是弯月和山峦，显得孤独而沉思。
[P23] 洛洛在深夜独自散步时，边走边想，突然想起了父母慈爱的面容，画面中他眼中含泪，脑海中浮现出父母微笑的影像。
[P24] 洛洛在深夜散步时，回忆起与父母一起玩耍的愉快时光，画面中他眼中含泪，脑海中浮现出父母在秋千上与他共度欢乐时光的温馨场景。
[P25] 洛洛在深夜散步时，回忆起妈妈对他的鼓励，画面中妈妈温柔地抚摸着他，传递着爱与支持。
[P26] 洛洛在深夜散步时回头望向家园，发现森林正着火，他惊恐地张大嘴巴，画面充满紧张与危机感。
[P27] 洛洛发现森林着火后，不顾一切地向森林飞奔而去，画面中他惊恐地奔跑，背景是蘑菇屋和燃烧的森林。
[P28] 洛洛在森林着火后，不顾发音不准，拼命奔跑并呼喊，试图唤醒正在熟睡的兔子们。
[P29] 洛洛的呼喊唤醒了所有兔子，大家纷纷行动起来，有的取水，有的救火，齐心协力与森林大火搏斗。
[P30] 森林大火被扑灭，洛洛成功救回了所有兔子和它们的家园，画面中兔子们疲惫但安然，背景是烧焦的森林。
[P31] 洛洛成功救火后，其他兔子意识到自己曾看不起洛洛是错误的，纷纷向他道歉，并承诺以后一起玩耍和学习。
[P32] 洛洛在父母的怀抱中，意识到自己应努力学习说话，并认识到尽管耳朵有缺陷，但自己仍有其他价值。
[P33] 本页为绘本《短耳朶的洛洛》的版权页，列出了作者、出版单位、印刷公司、出版日期、定价、ISBN等出版信息。
[P34] 本页为绘本的版权页，显示了图书的定价为10港元，并配有一幅洛洛开心大笑的插图。
